Backend: Express `backend/index.js`; routes `backend/src/routes/`, controllers `backend/src/controllers/`, repositories `backend/src/repositories/`; `RepositoryFactory` selects JSON-file or Mongo. Menu routes use multer `upload.single("image")`.

Frontend: React `frontend/src/`; admin UI `frontend/src/pages/admin/` (e.g. `adminhomes.jsx`). API client `frontend/src/lib/api.js` uses `fetch`, `credentials: 'include'`, detects `FormData`, unwraps responses (do not set `Content-Type` manually). Always double check `credentials: 'include'`.
